summary: Iteration 34 retest of the 7 fixes + the previously unreachable booking-snapshot path. 21 backend tests (2 new pytest modules) + Playwright checks on /safety, footer at 1920/768/390, the admin schedule modal floor guard, admin sidebar tabs, /p/terms and the sign-up wizard. PASSED: FIX 1 (quote 401 anon / 403 unrelated member / 200 owning vendor / 200 admin, quantity scaling, 404 unknown vendor, no terms leak), FIX 3 (PUT /api/admin/pages/{slug} works, previous version archived, /versions shows current v2 + archived v1, blocks + last_updated preserved, member 403), FIX 6 (4 footer groups side by side at 1920 with no overflow, 2 columns at 768, stacked at 390; footer-legal-note rgba(255,255,255,0.7) on #2A0836), FIX 7 (/safety renders all 8 seeded blocks + 'Last updated 19 August 2026 . version 2', 9 blocks rendered), BOOKING SNAPSHOT end to end (paid event order -> snapshot with agreement id/version + schedule id/version + all amounts equal to the pricing engine, vendor_settlements pending row with a correct T+15 due date visible at /api/vendor/settlements, other member 403, anonymous 401, snapshot unchanged after the vendor's commission was amended to 25%), ACCEPTANCE PATH re-verified TWICE end to end (amend -> amendment_pending -> 3/4 confirmations rejected 400 -> OTP -> accept -> active + executed PDF 200 %PDF), and the light regression (/me/ledger + invoice.pdf, /plans benefits, admin sidebar tab switching, /p/terms 21 h2 / 30 li unescaped). FAILED: FIX 4 (registration is 500 - record_signup_consents is called but never defined, so ALL sign-ups are broken), FIX 2 (accepting future-dated terms supersedes the effective schedule immediately, leaving a window with NO effective schedule: quote 404, no snapshot, no settlement row) and FIX 5 backend half (the amend endpoint still accepts pricing_floor > vendor_net_rate).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error - NameError: name 'record_signup_consents' is not defined (called at server.py L947 and L1074, never defined anywhere in the codebase; confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). ALL email sign-ups and all first-time Google sign-ups fail. Worse, db.users.insert_one runs BEFORE the crash, so an orphan user row with no token and no consents is left behind and a retry with the same email then returns 'An account with this email already exists.' FIX 4 is not delivered.

FIX 2 is only half done. accept_agreement() marks every other active schedule 'superseded' the moment the vendor accepts, even when the new schedule's effective_from is in the future, so between acceptance and effective_from the vendor has NO effective schedule: GET /api/pricing/quote returns 404 'No active commercial schedule', and a booking paid in that window is fulfilled with NO booking_commercial_snapshots row and NO vendor_settlements row (verified: order paid 200, snapshot 404, settlements 0 - vendor money silently untracked). The spec requires the currently effective version to keep applying until effective_from passes. After effective_from the new terms do apply correctly (net 1900 quoted).

FIX 5 server-side guard missing: pricing_floor 1500 with vendor_net_rate 1000 was accepted (200), created schedule v5 and agreement v1.4 and pushed the live vendor into amendment_pending. POST /admin/vendor-profiles/{vid}/commercial-schedule has the guard; amend() does not (the check is not shared). I rolled the vendor back manually.

minor.issue: Snapshot failure is swallowed with only a warning log (correct for fulfilment) but nothing surfaces it - the missing snapshot/settlement above is invisible to operators. Consider an admin alert or a reconciliation endpoint listing paid orders whose vendor has no snapshot.

ui_bugs.issue: Sign-up fails silently: with all four consents ticked, 'Create my account' fires the 500 and the UI shows NO error, toast or message - the user stays on step 4 with no feedback (only a console 'Failed to load resource: 500'). Add an error state for the register mutation.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be verified through the UI at all because /api/auth/register 500s (backend NameError).

design_issues.screen: Admin -> Vendor agreements -> Set/Amend terms modal
issues: 'Effective from' uses the native browser datetime-local picker instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere
Superseded agreement rows still expose Amend/Terminate actions, which invites amending a historical version
footer-legal-note is only 11px; contrast at rgba(255,255,255,0.7) on #2A0836 is acceptable but the size is at the edge of legibility
'Safety Centre' appears twice in the Safety & Trust group (duplicate link)

action_items: Define record_signup_consents(uid, email, request) in server.py (write policy_acceptances rows with slug terms/privacy/guidelines, source 'registration', current required versions) - registration is completely broken until then; also make the user insert + consent write fail-safe so no orphan user is left on error.
Show an error message/toast when POST /api/auth/register fails (Auth.jsx submit has no error state).

Fix future-dated terms: on acceptance, keep the currently effective schedule effective until the new schedule's effective_from (e.g. set effective_until on the old one instead of superseding immediately, and have active_schedule() fall back to the latest schedule whose effective_from <= now regardless of a later accepted version).
Move the pricing_floor <= vendor_net_rate validation into a shared validator used by BOTH create_schedule and amend_agreement (amend currently accepts it).
Optional: surface skipped commercial snapshots (log-only today) via an admin reconciliation view.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py calls record_signup_consents at two places but the function does not exist - a lint/import-time smoke test on the register path would have caught this before handoff.
vendor_routes.accept_agreement() supersedes all other active schedules unconditionally; the effective-date logic added to active_schedule() must be mirrored here or the two disagree.
Duplicate business rule: the pricing floor guard exists only in create_schedule; extract to a helper (DRY) so amend cannot bypass it.
server.py is 7441 lines - split the CMS/policy, commerce and auth sections into modules like vendor_routes.py.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Two real paid event orders were created for aarav.mehta@example.com against a SMOKE-vendor event to exercise snapshots/settlements (left in place deliberately, with their snapshots + vendor_settlements rows). TEST_ users created by the register attempts were deleted. The 'safety' CMS page policy_version went 1 -> 2 (content unchanged) as part of the FIX 3 test.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md used as-is (admin@buddilio.com/Admin@123, partner@buddilio.com/Partner@123, aarav.mehta@example.com and diya.sharma@example.com / User@123)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Current SMOKE Vendor LLP state after this run (restored by hand after the amend-guard bug): schedules v1/v2/v3 superseded, v4 ACTIVE (net 1900, commission 30%, platform fee 12%, tax 18%, T+15, effective_from 2026-08-19T21:29:52Z), agreements v1.0-v1.2 superseded, v1.3 ACTIVE and accepted with a PDF. policy_acceptance_required currently holds terms version 3, so seeded members will see the re-acceptance modal. Re-run: pytest tests/test_iteration34_fixes.py tests/test_iteration34_snapshot_future.py -n 0 (the snapshot module is order dependent and amends the vendor twice, each time completing a real OTP acceptance by recovering the code hash from agreement_otps). tests/i34_gap_impact.py reproduces the future-dated gap by temporarily pushing effective_from forward and restores it.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Registration: server.py L947/L1074 call record_signup_consents which was never implemented -> NameError -> 500 after the user document has already been inserted. 2) Future-dated terms: active_schedule() was correctly hardened to require effective_from <= now, but accept_agreement() still supersedes all other active schedules immediately, so a future-dated acceptance leaves the vendor with zero effective schedules; pricing_quote then 404s and snapshot_booking returns None, and vendor_snapshot_hook swallows it, so paid orders in that window carry no commercials or settlement. 3) Floor guard: the validation lives only in create_schedule, so the amend route bypasses it.
